questions.q: What are the three pipeline stages built across this project?
options: T-SQL extract, Python clean/join, Power BI model and report
A single Power BI file with no other stages
T-SQL, Power BI, Python
Excel, Power Query, Power BI
questions.explain: The full pipeline runs T-SQL extraction, then Python reconciliation, then Power BI modeling and reporting.

questions.q: What specific pandas functions solved the two real data problems from Lesson 4?
options: drop_duplicates() for the re-exported rows, and str.strip()/str.title()/fillna() for the inconsistent territory values
Power Query's Remove Duplicates button only
A single SQL query run twice
pd.read_csv() alone, with no other functions needed
questions.explain: drop_duplicates handled the duplicate-export problem; the string-cleaning and fillna calls handled the inconsistent TerritoryName values.

questions.q: What real Power BI limitation did Lesson 12 cover?
options: A Python-script data source needs a Personal Gateway installed on a Python-ready machine to refresh in the Service
DAX measures cannot use CALCULATE in the cloud
Power BI Desktop requires an internet connection to open any file
Power BI cannot connect to SQL Server at all
questions.explain: This is the real Gateway Limitation this project worked through.

questions.q: What debugging method diagnosed the field-binding bug in Lessons 13-15?
options: Reproduce the reported symptom, isolate the variable, confirm the hypothesis with a controlled test, then fix and validate broadly
Immediately rewriting every DAX measure in the model
Guessing which number was correct based on which stakeholder asked first
Deleting the suspect visual without investigation
questions.explain: This reproduce-isolate-confirm-fix-validate method is the real diagnostic discipline this chapter taught.

questions.q: What does the Advanced project in this capstone track build on top of?
options: Only new DAX syntax, with no pipeline work at all
A rebuild of the Beginner project from scratch
An entirely unrelated dataset with no connection to this project
This project's same real shape -- more stakeholders, a bigger pipeline, and new failure modes beyond one mis-bound card
questions.explain: The Advanced project scales up the same discipline: profile before cleaning, clean in code, diagnose before fixing.
